title: Render card images with empty alternate text as decorative
body: > Related to #5747 ## Changelog Entry - Fixed card images with empty alternate text (`altText: ""` in Adaptive Cards or `alt: ""` in rich cards) not being rendered as decorative images, related to [#5747](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/issues/5747), in PR [#5877](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5877), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny) ## Description Adaptive Cards (3.0.6) sets `alt` only when the alternate text is not empty. So an image sent with `altText: ""` (Adaptive Card `Image`) or `alt: ""` (hero, thumbnail, receipt card) rendered without `alt`, exactly like an image without alternate text (role `image`, empty name, axe `image-alt`), and bots could not mark images as decorative. This PR adds an Adaptive Card mod that renders these images with `alt=""`. The scenario reported in #5747 is unchanged: the mock bot sends `alt: "Details about image N"` and Web Chat renders it as given. With this fix, the bot can send `alt: ""` instead. ## Design - The mod follows the existing mods in `AdaptiveCardHacks/`. It finds each `` owner with `findDOMNodeOwner()`, checks `getJsonTypeName() === 'Image'` instead of `instanceof` (web devs may bring their own Adaptive Cards package), and checks `altText === ''` with valibot. The Adaptive Cards parser and the rich card conversion (`AdaptiveCardBuilder.addImage`) both keep `""`, so an empty alt can be told apart from a missing one. Because the mod runs through `useAdaptiveCardModEffect`, it is reapplied after DOM mutations, which covers images shown by `Action.ShowCard`. - Images with a select action (a hero card image with `tap`, or an `Image` with `selectAction`) get a `button` or `link` role from Adaptive Cards. They are interactive, not decorative: their accessible name comes from the action title (`aria-label`), and `alt=""` would not change it. axe also reports `presentation-role-conflict` on a focusable `` with ARIA attributes. The mod skips them (`img:not([role])`). - Images **without** alternate text are unchanged. Only the bot knows whether an image is decorative. Treating a missing alt as decorative would hide informative images and mask bot authoring errors (WCAG [F65](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Techniques/failures/F65)). - If `adaptivecards` rendered `alt=""` for an empty `altText` (today `Image.internalRender` skips falsy values), this mod could be removed. The mod has a `TODO` for this. ## Specific Changes - Added `useImageAltTextModEffect` in `packages/bundle/src/adaptiveCards/Attachment/AdaptiveCardHacks/`: it sets `alt=""` on images whose `altText` is `""`, except images with a role - Applied the mod in `AdaptiveCardRenderer.tsx` alongside the existing mods (undo before render, apply after render) - Added `__tests__/html2/accessibility/adaptiveCard/hack.imageAltTextMod.html`. The test checks `alt` and the accessibility node (CDP) for: - hero cards with empty and non-empty alt - a thumbnail card with empty alt - Adaptive Card `Image` elements with empty and non-empty `altText`, including inside `ImageSet` and `ColumnSet` and with `selectAction` - the test passes the default accessibility check - [x] I have added tests and executed them locally - [x] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` - [ ] I have updated documentation ## Review Checklist > This section is for contributors to review your work. - [ ] Accessibility reviewed (tab order, content readability, alt text, color contrast) - [ ] Browser and platform compatibilities reviewed - [ ] CSS styles reviewed (minimal rules, no `z-index`) - [ ] Documents reviewed (docs, samples, live demo) - [ ] Internationalization reviewed (strings, unit formatting) - [ ] `package.json` and `package-lock.json` reviewed - [ ] Security reviewed (no data URIs, check for nonce leak) - [ ] Tests reviewed (coverage, legitimacy)
